name: inova-gastro-360
description: Inova Gastro 360 — SaaS para hamburgueria, delivery e gestão operacional

scripts.dev:stack: node scripts/clean-web.mjs && concurrently -n web,api,msg,rt,int -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:msg" "npm run dev:rt" "npm run dev:integrations"
scripts.deploy:workers: npm run deploy -w @inova-gastro-360/integrations && npm run deploy -w @inova-gastro-360/realtime-hub && npm run deploy -w @inova-gastro-360/messaging-bus && npm run deploy -w @inova-gastro-360/api-gateway
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build:pages -w @inova-gastro-360/web && npm run deploy:web -w @inova-gastro-360/web
scripts.start:web:prod: npm run build -w @inova-gastro-360/web && npm run start -w @inova-gastro-360/web
scripts.start:stack: node scripts/free-stack-ports.mjs && concurrently -n int,rt,msg,api,web -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green,blue "npm run start:integrations" "npm run start:rt" "npm run start:msg" "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web:prod"
